records.query: How do I submit a return request on the Tiki app and schedule the free courier pickup?
records.full_draft_text: To submit a return or exchange request on the Tiki app, navigate to 'Account' > 'Order Management' > select the order with 'Delivered' status > tap 'Request Return/Exchange'. Then, select the reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video demonstrating the product defect. Once Tiki receives the request, a shipping courier will pick up the item directly from your address for free within 1-2 business days, or you can drop off the package at a designated Tiki partner post office.

POL-RET-002:2.0.title: Return and Exchange Request Process and Steps on Tiki App
POL-RET-002:2.0.content: To create a return or exchange request, customers navigate to 'Account' > 'Order Management' > select the order with 'Delivered' status > tap 'Request Return/Exchange'. Customers select the reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video demonstrating the product defect. Once the request is received by Tiki, shipping couriers will pick up the item directly from the customer's address for free within 1-2 business days, or customers may drop off the package at designated Tiki partner post offices.

POL-SHIP-004:1.0.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
POL-SHIP-004:1.0.content: In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

POL-ORD-002:1.0.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
POL-ORD-002:1.0.content: Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. Once the order transitions to 'In Transit', the direct cancellation button is disabled; customers should reject the package upon courier contact. For canceled prepaid orders, refunds will be issued automatically according to Tiki refund policies.

POL-REFUND-001:1.0.title: Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
POL-REFUND-001:1.0.content: Refund requests are only processed once an order has been successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel; AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. Original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

POL-ORD-001:1.0.title: Instructions for Tracking Order Journey and Status on Tiki
POL-ORD-001:1.0.content: Customers can check order status by navigating to 'My Orders' on the Tiki app. Order statuses include: 'Pending Confirmation' (seller preparing), 'Pick Up in Progress' (packed, awaiting courier), 'In Transit' (courier delivering, real-time tracking code provided), 'Delivered' (completed), and 'Canceled'. Customers tap the tracking code to view details of each transit hub the parcel has passed through.

POL-ORD-003:1.0.title: Instructions for Changing Delivery Address or Phone Number After Placing Order
POL-ORD-003:1.0.content: Customers may change the delivery address or phone number only once per order, provided the order remains in 'Pending Processing' status. When an order advances to 'Preparing Items' or 'Handed Over to Courier', modification features are locked to prevent parcel misrouting. Customers should contact the courier upon phone contact to arrange delivery at a nearby location.
